title: Restricted local attention needed for very long sequences
description: Self-attention's computational cost grows quadratically with sequence length. For tasks involving very long sequences, the authors note that self-attention could be restricted to a local neighborhood and state that they plan to investigate this approach further in future work.
canonical_description: local restricted attention needed for efficient handling of long sequences

evidence.anchor: restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size
evidence.quote: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position.
